issue.title: Guide: inspect and share Projects statistics from the CLI with sase stats project

task_type_fields.proposal:
Guide candidate proposed by phase sase-1m3.10 (note #2, epic sase-1m3): add one
task-oriented Guide page under `docs/guides/` that walks a reader through inspecting and
sharing the Admin Center Statistics → Projects report from the CLI with `sase stats
project` — reading the card and coverage line, switching `-r` ranges and `-g`
groupings (project/repo/model/patch), narrowing with `-p`, refreshing refs with `-F`,
and exporting with `-f markdown` or `-j` (piping the versioned JSON envelope to `jq`).
Link facts from `docs/reference/cli/stats.md` and `docs/reference/tui/admin-center.md`
rather than restating them, and follow `docs/contribute/writing-docs.md` (Guide tier,
one goal per page).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
Epic sase-1m3 built the command and its generated reference page; its phase workers may
not create beads or new Guide pages, and the docs routing rule records guide candidates
as tasks for the docs-editor flow (see sase-1m1, sase-1m8) instead.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1m3.10 recorded a guide candidate for the new sase stats project command; guide candidates are tracked as feature tasks for the docs-editor flow.
